limitations: Originality is restricted to the all-connected-bipartite BHM equality classification and the quantitative standard-to-lazy gap transfer. Wu--Xu--Zhu (2016) already prove unique-path equality for both tree models, and Zhu (2026) gives strict lazy inequality on graphs containing a cycle, so the all-connected lazy uniqueness statement is retained only as a prior consequence/consistency corollary. The stronger stochastic-domination form of BHM is not addressed, the factor p_G may be exponentially small, and very recent parallel work remains possible.
record_title: Unique BHM maximizers and a quantitative standard-to-lazy gap transfer
